cells.gaps: No adopting act or date is named for the strategy (approval is the finance minister's statement of 19 February 2025 and a World Bank document). The strategy's text sets initiatives by priority with start windows counted from operationalisation, not calendar dates, and states no cost (LSO-039); the policy of the same year lists its detailed action plan as still to be developed (LSO-009), so the delivery plan is read conservatively as none. The text makes the Chief Digital Office accountable for the strategy and its monitoring (LSO-040); no finance row and no results report against its targets is held, only a claim of implementation (LSO-001). The National Digital Policy 2024-2035 (LSO-004 to LSO-007, LSO-010) is a second adopted national instrument, also stage 3; the strategy is the newer adoption and the one the study names.
cells.note: National Digital Transformation Strategy: Agenda 2030: approved per the 2025 budget speech, text on gov.ls, period to 2030. No results against its targets are held, so it stops at 3.
